findings.input: Подтверждаю завершение в Москве после Дубая. Начало всё ещё Казань, не меняй его на Москву.
findings.raw_model_fact: The validated final JSON had only set_route_policy(open_jaw, Moscow), no lodging edit.
findings.checked_failure: Route guard suppressed the endpoint; current-literal grounding inserted upsert_stay(Moscow).
findings.fix: Recognize bounded current nominal ending cues, keep alternatives before the prior-stop context, and protect endpoint role from lodging extraction even with no valid policy op.
findings.limit: The previous wrong Saint Petersburg origin already existed before T7; this fix does not claim to restore Kazan.

findings.input: Нас четверо, хотим из Санкт-Петербурга в Сочи. Возраст и состав я ещё не перечислил, не угадывай.
findings.raw_model_fact: The validated final JSON invented four adult additions; checked operations preserved them without normalizations.
findings.fix: For a fresh party with explicitly unknown composition and a proved total, remove guessed category additions and their dependent memberships, keep independent facts, and persist an addressed count question.
findings.limit: Bounded initial unknown-composition guard, not general person/category attribution. Known adults with unknown ages and existing parties remain outside scope.
